rules.function_unit: One independently invokable function per node
rules.invocation_unit: One target function per request; revisits permitted
rules.publication: External verification and committed capability/UI publication
rules.blockers: External cause, evidence, impact, remedies, bounded attempts
rules.safe_failover: Missing provider: docs/validation only; no implicit write failover
rules.ui_fallback: Raw UI draft only; unverified actions cannot execute
rules.commit: External CAS visibility commit; Forge emits recipes only
rules.invalidation: External reverse-index lookup, UI revoke and revisit
rules.blocker_explanation: Explicit cause, evidence, impact and remedies required
rules.provider_negotiation: Untrusted snapshot matching; host must authorize
rules.events: Untrusted ordered event projection; no cursor ownership
rules.integration: External host dispatch intent, per-call reauthorization and CAS
rules.visibility: Untrusted receipt coherence; host owns UI confirmation
rules.composite: Recursive groups contain shared atomic function references
rules.shared_references: Repeated UI mounts share one function and handler
rules.dependency_cycles: Reject local cycles; flag unresolved external dependencies
rules.impact: Pure reverse impact projection from supplied graph
rules.distributed_placement: Explicit write-primary placements; no host selection
rules.distributed_publication: External fencing, verification, staged UI and readback
rules.partial_failure: Explain partial writes; no blind retry or compensation
rules.reactive_stream: External ordered revision stream; reject gaps, forks and duplicate function updates
rules.reactive_ui: Unexecuted staged UI diff and CAS commit; Forge never updates user interface
rules.ui_cursor_ack: UI commit and stream cursor must match same graph/policy revisions and transaction set
rules.personalized_ui: Per-principal candidate projection; deny/revoke wins; never grants execution
rules.session_recovery: External cursor replay candidate or full resnapshot; invalidate cached UI actions
rules.identity_recheck: Every reconnect and action requires authoritative host authorization
